CREATE FUNCTION CDN.KorektyUNM(@GIDNumer INT,@MODE SMALLINT = 0) RETURNS @t1 TABLE(GIDLp SMALLINT PRIMARY KEY,SumaRoz DECIMAL(15,2),SumaPrz DECIMAL(15,2),WalutaDT VARCHAR(3),SumaRozWal DECIMAL(15,2),WalutaCT VARCHAR(3),SumaPrzWal DECIMAL(15,2)) AS BEGIN DECLARE @KWOTA DECIMAL(15,2) DECLARE @KwotaDTWal DECIMAL(15,2) DECLARE @KwotaCTWal DECIMAL(15,2) DECLARE @WalutaDT VARCHAR(3) DECLARE @WalutaCT VARCHAR(3) DECLARE @ORG_GIDNumer INT DECLARE @Typ SMALLINT DECLARE @count INT DECLARE @MEE_GIDLp SMALLINT SET @KWOTA = 0 SET @Typ = 0 SET @MEE_GIDLp = 0 SET @WalutaDT = '' SET @WalutaCT = '' SET @KwotaDTWal = 0 SET @KwotaCTWal = 0
INSERT INTO @t1 SELECT MEE_GIDLp,0,0,MEE_WalutaDT,0,MEE_WalutaCT,0 from cdn.MemElem where @GIDNumer = MEE_GIDNumer Order by MEE_GIDLp
WHILE (@GIDNumer <> 0) BEGIN DECLARE poz_mee CURSOR FOR SELECT MEE_GIDLp,MEE_Kwota,MEE_Typ,MEE_WalutaDT,MEE_KwotaDTWal,MEE_WalutaCT,MEE_KwotaCTWal FROM cdn.MemElem WHERE MEE_GIDNumer = @GIDNumer ORDER BY MEE_GIDLp
OPEN poz_mee FETCH NEXT FROM poz_mee INTO @MEE_GIDLp, @KWOTA, @Typ,@WalutaDT,@KwotaDTWal,@WalutaCT,@KwotaCTWal
IF @MODE = 0 BEGIN WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
IF @Typ = 1 UPDATE @t1 SET SumaPrz = SumaPrz + @KWOTA,SumaPrzWal = SumaPrzWal + @KwotaCTWal Where GIDLp = @MEE_GIDLp IF @Typ = 2 UPDATE @t1 SET SumaRoz = SumaRoz + @KWOTA,SumaRozWal = SumaRozWal + @KwotaDTWal Where GIDLp = @MEE_GIDLp IF @Typ = 3 UPDATE @t1 SET SumaPrz = SumaPrz + @KWOTA, SumaRozWal = SumaRozWal + @KwotaDTWal , SumaRoz = SumaRoz + @KWOTA,SumaPrzWal = SumaPrzWal + @KwotaCTWal Where GIDLp = @MEE_GIDLp -- SELECT @MEE_GIDLp, @KWOTA, @Typ,@GIDNumer
FETCH NEXT FROM poz_mee INTO @MEE_GIDLp, @KWOTA, @Typ,@WalutaDT,@KwotaDTWal,@WalutaCT,@KwotaCTWal END END ELSE IF @MODE = 1 BEGIN SET @MODE = 0 END CLOSE poz_mee DEALLOCATE poz_mee SELECT @GIDNumer = MEN_ORGNumer from cdn.MemNag where @GIDNumer = MEN_GIDNumer END
RETURN
END
